title: Isandro and the Inheritance
author: Coral Oyelaran
blurb: Oscar Vasquez, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
